fields.Name: T247 - Tasks Tab Full View
fields.Description: Exercises the activeTab='tasks' branch rendering TasksFullViewComponent with the mj-task widget list — distinct from the top-nav tasks dropdown and from the Collections view.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the Chat application and wait for the workspace. Click the 'Tasks' tab in the top navigation. Confirm the main area switches to the tasks full view showing a list of task cards/widgets (with status and progress) OR a valid empty state if there are no tasks. Optionally click into a task to confirm a detail/breadcrumb view opens. Seeing the tasks view render is success regardless of task count. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Tasks tab swaps the main area to the tasks full view
Task widgets/cards render with status/progress OR a clear no-tasks empty state is shown
The view is stable (clicking a task, if present, opens its detail without crashing)
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
